name: Tendou Kouji
source:
The protagonist. He found passion in drawing and shows high degree of talent for it. With a friendly and approachable personality, strong likes and dislikes, and the ability to act selfish and get away with it, he has some childishness left in him - in a good sense of the word - and reaps the benefits that come with it.

[Translated from [url=https://www.saibunkan.co.jp/scramble/jin/rena/other.html]Scramble HOUSE's official website[/url]]
